name: nexus-ai
description: Nexus AI — atelier local d’orchestration d’agents.

scripts.test: pnpm run generate && node --test "packages/*/test/**/*.test.ts" && pnpm --filter @nexus/desktop run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run generate && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @nexus/desktop run typecheck
scripts.lint: oxlint packages apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/e2e apps/desktop/tests tests spikes && oxfmt --check --ignore-path .gitignore packages apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/e2e apps/desktop/tests
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix packages apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/e2e apps/desktop/tests tests spikes && oxfmt --write --ignore-path .gitignore packages apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/e2e apps/desktop/tests
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test

author: Dayifour (https://github.com/Dayifour)
